records.issue_text: Controller specs invoke actions directly and bypass route parameter recognition, so they don't catch the :group_id vs :id routing mismatch
records.rationale: The diff shows the new admin group membership routes use `group_id` (routes under `resources :groups` and controller actions `add_members`/`remove_member` both do `params.require(:group_id)`), and the controller specs pass `group_id:` accordingly. There is no verifiable `:group_id` vs `:id` mismatch introduced here for the specs to “miss.”

records.issue_text: No test coverage (e.g. assert_routing or integration/request spec) exercises the actual DELETE/PUT /admin/groups/:id/members routes to catch the group_id vs id param mismatch
records.rationale: The diff’s route definition is inside `resources :groups`, so the member segment is named after the resource (i.e. `:group_id`), matching the controller’s `params.require(:group_id)` in `add_members`/`remove_member`. There’s no verifiable `group_id` vs `id` param mismatch introduced here. While the specs don’t assert routing, the finding’s stated mismatch is not supported by the diff.
